How to sign up with Vantro

It takes about five minutes: your details, a quick ID check and a deposit limit. You can bet as soon as you are verified.

Join Vantro

Step by step

Opening your account

  1. 1

    Enter your details

    Full name, date of birth, residential address, email and mobile number.

  2. 2

    Verify your identity

    Vantro checks your details electronically. If that fails, upload a driver licence or passport.

  3. 3

    Set a limit and deposit

    Choose a daily, weekly or monthly deposit limit, then deposit from A$10. PayID is instant.

Before you start

What you need

Be 18 or over

And live in Australia. Vantro verifies both before you can bet.

Photo ID, just in case

Driver licence or passport, only if the electronic check cannot confirm you.

A bank account

In your own name, for PayID, BPAY or debit card payments.

Why Vantro checks your identity

Australian wagering providers must verify every customer's identity and age before they can bet. Vantro runs the check electronically against official records, so most people never need to upload anything.

What happens if the check fails

You will be asked for a photo of your driver licence or passport. Manual checks usually take under an hour during business hours. You can browse markets while you wait, but you cannot place a bet.

One account per person

Each person can hold one Vantro account. If you already had one and closed it, contact support to reopen it instead of signing up again.

After you sign up

Set up your deposit method on the payments page, or get the Vantro app to bet on your phone.

Questions before you join

Do I need to upload ID?

Usually not. Most accounts are verified electronically within minutes.

Can I sign up in the app?

Yes. The steps are the same on the website and in the app.

Why must I set a deposit limit?

Australian rules require you to be offered a deposit limit at sign-up. You can choose any amount and change it later.

Can I change my email or phone later?

Yes, under Account → Details. Name and date of birth changes need support.
